title: Horseshoe Pitching
tagline: Flip it, clank it, ring the stake.
description: The back-yard classic of the United States and Canada. Pitch a steel shoe forty feet at the stake, time your release in the green, and outplay five rivals, a partner game or a friend.
howToPlay: Drag the target on the pit board to where the shoe should rest.
Choose a three-quarter or one-and-a-quarter flip.
Hold PITCH and let go while the arm is in the green.
A ringer scores 3; the closest shoe within 6 inches scores 1.
